items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Zutty Singleton) does not speak in the provided transcript. The mention of Shorty Baker is made solely by the Interviewer.

ctx.x: Shorty Baker, oh, yeah. But Clark Terry, he never worked under Charlie but Shorty Baker did.
Yeah. I mean, Shorty, he was a fine trumpet.
Yeah. And Irving Randolph. Now he's out of the business. Ham Davis, Leonard Davis. He's dead, they called him Ham. Oh, we had so many musicians.
